dedupe_keys.name: brazil future weather files for building energy simulation state capitals epw

description: This dataset provides future hourly weather files for building energy simulation in all Brazilian state capitals and the Federal District. It was produced by the Laboratory of Energy Efficiency in Buildings at the Universidade Federal de Santa Catarina with the National Institute for Space Research (INPE), and is documented in the Journal of Building Engineering (2024). Typical meteorological years are built for 2010, 2050 and 2090 from CORDEX-CORE projections, an ensemble of six members from three global models (HadGEM2, MPI-ESM, NorESM1) and two regional models (RegCM, REMO) at about 25 km, under RCP 2.6 and RCP 8.5, bias-corrected against historical observations, so users can study uncertainty across models. Access: version 1.1.1 was published on Zenodo on 11 September 2024, with TMY files in EPW format for EnergyPlus and, in this version, the complete individual years in CSV. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: the all-years archive is about 6 GB, and future years are statistical constructions, not forecasts. Simulation uses are climate-change stress tests of building energy use, overheating and thermal comfort, and adaptation of building codes. Related records: EnergyPlus and the CAHDC climate-adjusted HVAC design conditions.
